'''Kodo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Along with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dogah]] he accompanied [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ziliss]] to the [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] [[Jedi Enclave]] where they fought the [[Alliance Commander]], [[Arn Peralun]], and [[Aryn Leneer]] and were killed.<ref name="TOR" />
